faqs.a:
The right is hereby reserved to the city and the city council to adopt, in addition
               to the provisions contained in this article and in existing applicable ordinances
               and regulations, such additional ordinances or regulations, or both, as it shall find
               necessary in the exercise of its police power; provided that such ordinances and regulations
               shall be reasonable and not in conflict with the rights granted by the city to the
               permittee.
(Code 1981, § 9-7; Ord. No. 3136, § 1, 11-28-1994)
